result.name: QFORM-PHYSICAL-TRIPLE-DET-ONE-THIRD-v2
result.statement: For an invertible symmetric physical 3x3 coefficient matrix M and independent cap-one inputs, including arbitrary affine terms, the output density satisfies ||p||_inf <= 12(1+pi)|det M|^(-1/3). Ambient conditioning gives the same bound for any physical principal triple.
result.regularity: essentially bounded density; continuity not proved by this receiver
result.mechanism: determinant-only physical-pair envelope plus scalar square one-third Riesz; exact Schur determinant cancellation; coefficient perturbation handles all-principal-pairs-singular edge case

fresh_application.conclusion: Exact-rank-three normalized overlap-two sector E2/Delta^2>=1/4 is fully paid: pair-star branch <333.880; dominant principal-triple branch <143.358, with no anisotropy gate.

designated_partner_application.regularity: continuous C0 on that partner branch
